propositions: A prerequisite-consistency criterion must evaluate whether a plan remains consistent with each direct upstream dependency without leaking prerequisite material into general reviewers.

Focused finder and verifier passes must route prerequisite blocks through isolated prompts and verify attribution of incompatibility findings to specific prerequisite IDs, with indeterminate coverage forcing unsigned INDETERMINATE at the terminal verdict.
Any indeterminate prerequisite record must yield unsigned top-level INDETERMINATE, while retained DET blockers remain visible in the blocking array.
Focused Pass-1 and Pass-2 must operate in separate non-overlapping index domains from general findings, independently reshaped and concatenated after single shared execution-aware Pass-3.
Singleton focused finder must achieve recall ≥0.90, false-acceptance ≤0.10, coverage=1.00, and attribution-error=0.00 before packed batching or production wiring is permitted.

Finding identity for prerequisite-scoped findings must use canonical length-prefixed UTF-8 encoding of version, text, criteria, and prerequisite ID, while all non-prerequisite findings retain existing pipe-delimited encoding unchanged.
